profileLabel: Slight center-left economics; liberal-leaning social values (medium confidence)
summary: Quezon City 5th District representative with about 416 principal-authored bills. Authored SOGIE anti-discrimination, paternity leave amendments, K-12 employment anti-discrimination, a right to disconnect, freelancer protection, health benefits for informal workers, VAT suspension on essential food, MSME compliance-cost relief, a false-information ban and right-to-information. Co-authored national minimum wage and a Revised Labor Code.
caveat: Pro-business MSME relief offsets labor and health bills, so economics is only slightly left. The false-information bill is a single speech issue and is not scored. Bill-based; no votes.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored labor protections including right to disconnect, paternity leave and freelancer protection (-2), health benefits for informal workers (-3) and VAT suspension on food (-1), offset by MSME compliance-cost reduction (+1). Four issues, bill-based.
